description.content:
Welcome to The Racing API

The Racing API provides a set of RESTful JSON endpoints, returning horse racing data from our database of over 500,000 results and pre-race racecards. The API is designed to meet the needs of application developers, data scientists, businesses and websites requiring punctual and accurate horse racing data.

This API reference contains the technical documentation users will require to connect their integrations and third-party applications.

FAQ | Data Coverage | Terms of Service

For support or feature requests, please email support@theracingapi.com.

Once you subscribe to The Racing API, you will be able to login to your dashboard and view your API username and password.

In order to authenticate your requests, you should use HTTP Basic Authentication, passing your username and password (Base64 encoded) in the Authorization header of your request.

If your account becomes inactive, your invoice payment is overdue or you attempt to access endpoints not available to your subscription level, requests will return a 401 Unauthorized response.

Default limits for the API are 5 requests per second for paid plans. Free plan users are limited to 1 request per second.

Some endpoints may have higher or lower rate limits than the default - these are specified in the documentation for each endpoint.

Exceeding the rate limit for a given endpoint will return a 429 Too Many Requests response.

Additional IP based rate limits are applied via Cloudflare as a protective measure for the services endpoints - exceeding these will trigger cooling off periods before requests from that IP address are accepted again:

  • >100 requests received in a 10 second period - 5 minutes cooling off
  • >500 requests received in a 10 second period - 30 minutes cooling off

We constantly monitor traffic and may temporarily manually block any user's API keys and IP/IP ranges where we detect problematic activity - we will notify the user via email if this happens, and reinstate access once the problematic activity/excessive requests have ceased.

Core API

The Racing API's Core API provides access to our primary horse racing data set, containing over three decades of horse racing results and updating with the latest data every 5 minutes.

This API provides full pre and post race data coverage of UK and Irish horse racing, as well as global coverage of group level races and selected handicaps. You can view a breakdown of coverage by year and region here

Every user who subscribes to The Racing API gains access to some or all of the Core API endpoints, subject to their specific plan level.

The Core API is divided in to 11 top-level categories:

Endpoint Category Description
/courses/ Course and region data, such as course names, course ids and region codes.
/dams/ Dam data and analysis. Dams can be searched for by name and results/analysis of their progeny's race performances can be queried by dam id.
/damsires/ Damsire data and analysis. Damsires can be searched for by name and results/analysis of their grand offspring's race performances can be queried by damsire id.
/horses/ Horse data and analysis. Horses can be searched for by name and results/analysis of their race performances can be queried by horse id.
/jockeys/ Jockey data and analysis. Jockeys can be searched for by name and results/analysis of their race performances can be queried by jockey id.
/odds/ Detailed odds data for a given runner, including price movements.
/owners/ Owner data and analysis. Owners can be searched for by name and results/analysis of their horse's race performances can be queried by owner id.
/racecards/ Detailed racecard (pre-race) data.
/results/ Detailed results (post-race) data.
/sires/ Sire data and analysis. Sires can be searched for by name and results/analysis of their progeny's race performances can be queried by sire id.
/trainers/ Trainer data and analysis. Trainers can be searched for by name and results/analysis of their horses's race performances can be queried by trainer id.

Core API Endpoints By Plan Level

We have also grouped the core API endpoints by plan level to make it easier to find the endpoints relevant to your API key permissions:

  • Free Plan endpoints
  • Basic Plan endpoints
  • Standard Plan endpoints
  • Pro Plan endpoints

Analysis Endpoints

The Core API's analysis endpoints perform data aggregation to return helpful betting & probability insights.

The statistics returned by these endpoints include:

  • Win Percentage (win_%): The number of wins divided by total runs/rides for a given query. For example, a win_% figure of 0.18 represents an 18% win percentage.
  • 1 Unit Profit/Loss (1_pl): Profit/loss for total rides/runs for a given query, if a 1 unit stake was placed at SP.
  • Actual/Expected (a/e): Actual number of wins, divided by expected number of wins for a given query. Expected number of wins is calculated from SP. For a detailed explanation of this statistic, see here.

IMPORTANT NOTE: Anaysis endpoints only perform data aggregation on results for which SP odds are available.

Regional API's

The Regional APIs provide access to additional data sets that provide complete coverage for a given region. The data and fields returned are also much more specific to that region than they may be in the Core API.

Accessing the endpoints for these data sets requires purchasing the relevant regional data add-on for your plan, which can be requested by emailing support@theracingapi.com.

The following top-level regional endpoints are available:
Region Description
/australia/ Meets and races for Australia
/north-america/ Meets, entries and results for the USA and Canada

v1.4.3 (Current - February 2026)

  • OpenAPI Response Examples - Added rich response examples to Pydantic models for all regions
  • Pydantic v2 Migration - Upgraded to Pydantic 2 with model updates
  • Analytics Backend Optimization - New synchronised columnar database for results data, utilised by analysis endpoints for substantially improved performance
  • Default Date Parameters - Results endpoints now include default date parameters

v1.4.2 (January 2026)

  • Async Database Operations - Full async migration for database operations
  • Enhanced Documentation - Code examples and endpoints organized by plan level
  • Improved Error Tracking - Optimized error tracing

v1.4.1 (December 2025)

  • Autoscaling - Added dynamic worker scaling
  • Enhanced Error Monitoring - Improved error tracking and monitoring
  • Database Compression - Added compression for database connections
  • Australia Date Validation - Improved date handling for Australia endpoints

v1.4.0 (August-October 2025)

  • Australia Regional API - Full Australia racing data support (meets, races, runners)
  • Australia Historical Results Add-on - Historical data access as add-on feature
  • Odds History - Optional bookmaker odds history

v1.3.1 (June-July 2025)

  • Response Compression - GZip compression middleware
  • Faster Serialization - Optimized JSON serialization for responses
  • Racecard Sorting - Improved racecard ordering
  • Health Check Endpoint - Added /health endpoint

v1.3.0 (July-August 2023)

  • North America Regional API - Full North America racing data support (meets, entries, results)
  • Meets Endpoint - Track meet information
  • Racecard Summaries - Lightweight racecard summary endpoint
  • Jumps Racing Filter - Filter racecards by jumps/flat racing

v1.2.0 (April-June 2023)

  • Odds Data - Live odds data for racecards
  • Pro Tier - New Pro subscription tier with advanced features
  • Pro Add-on Support - Add-on purchases for additional features
  • Big Races Endpoints - Featured/notable race identification
  • Endpoint Deprecation System - Managed deprecation for API versioning

v1.1.0 (February-March 2023)

  • Region Support - GB/IE region filtering for results
  • Today's Results - Dedicated today's results endpoint
  • Historic Results - Date range queries for historical data
  • Big Races Feature - Big race entries identification
  • Silk URLs - Jockey silk image URLs in responses

v1.0.0 (January 2023 - Initial Release)

  • Core API - FastAPI-based REST API
  • API Authentication - Secure authentication system
  • Racecards Endpoints - Basic and advanced racecards
  • Courses Endpoint - List courses with region filtering
  • Results Endpoints - Horse racing results
  • Error Tracking - Integrated error tracking

request.name: The Racing API Results

description.content:
Get historic results for all races in the last 12 months

Min. Required PlanStandard
Rate Limit5 requests per second
Add-ons[Optional] Core database historical results add-on: users on the Pro Plan can pay a one-time fee of £499 to remove the 12 month restriction and access over 30 years of results from this endpoint. Contact support@theracingapi.com for information.

Efficiently querying and exporting results data

While the parameters for this endpoint allow for a wide date range to be set (utilising 'start_date' and 'end_date'), the necessary use of 'skip' to access all results for a wide date range query will reduce perfomance the larger that range is.

ℹ️ The most efficient way to query results data over time is to build a list of dates within your date range, then make queries for each date in that list. A sample python script outlining this method can be viewed here: https://gist.github.com/theracingapi/4d492dbdba58c2072fe4f98ee090126f

query.description:
Query from date with format YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2020-01-01

Default: 365 days ago. Limited to up to 365 days in the past; pro plan users can purchase the historical results add-on to remove this limitation and query back to 1988-01-01.

request.name: The Racing API Results

description.content:
Get historic results for all races in the last 12 months

Min. Required PlanStandard
Rate Limit5 requests per second
Add-ons[Optional] Core database historical results add-on: users on the Pro Plan can pay a one-time fee of £499 to remove the 12 month restriction and access over 30 years of results from this endpoint. Contact support@theracingapi.com for information.

Efficiently querying and exporting results data

While the parameters for this endpoint allow for a wide date range to be set (utilising 'start_date' and 'end_date'), the necessary use of 'skip' to access all results for a wide date range query will reduce perfomance the larger that range is.

ℹ️ The most efficient way to query results data over time is to build a list of dates within your date range, then make queries for each date in that list. A sample python script outlining this method can be viewed here: https://gist.github.com/theracingapi/4d492dbdba58c2072fe4f98ee090126f

request.name: The Racing API Results

description.content:
Get historic results for all races in the last 12 months

Min. Required PlanStandard
Rate Limit5 requests per second
Add-ons[Optional] Core database historical results add-on: users on the Pro Plan can pay a one-time fee of £499 to remove the 12 month restriction and access over 30 years of results from this endpoint. Contact support@theracingapi.com for information.

Efficiently querying and exporting results data

While the parameters for this endpoint allow for a wide date range to be set (utilising 'start_date' and 'end_date'), the necessary use of 'skip' to access all results for a wide date range query will reduce perfomance the larger that range is.

ℹ️ The most efficient way to query results data over time is to build a list of dates within your date range, then make queries for each date in that list. A sample python script outlining this method can be viewed here: https://gist.github.com/theracingapi/4d492dbdba58c2072fe4f98ee090126f
